content.text:
I fixed the orders table. Its header row had only five columns, but each order row has six cells. The "Total" heading was missing. That left the headings out of line with the data, so the Status heading sat over the Total column and the actions column had no heading of its own.

The fix is one added line in `site/orders.html`: `<th class="num">Total</th>`, placed before the Actions heading. The total column is now right-aligned like its values.

The 16 functional tests pass. I did not look at the page in a browser, so the layout fix is unchecked visually. The CSS needed no changes.

STATUS: DONE
